name: Job Monitoring
description: Job Monitoring dashboards helps you to monitor Job Run duration, Status, Slowest Jobs, failed jobs, failed Test cases along with the stack trace for failure, sailed stages along with the exact command of failure, source control management details along with commit information, job configuration changes and stage wise console logs.

children.name: Console Logs by Stages

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* _sourceName={{Job_Name}}#*
| parse field=_raw "[*] *" as Log_Time, Log_Message
| trim (Log_Message)
| parse regex field=_sourceName "(?<Job_Name>.*?)#(?<Build_Number>[0-9]+)(?<Stage_Name>.*)" nodrop
| count by Log_Time, Job_Name, Build_Number, Stage_Name, Log_Message
| sort by Log_Time
| fields Log_Time, Job_Name, Build_Number, Stage_Name, Log_Message

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number", "hudsonVersion", "label", "result", "description", "jobType", "user", "nodeName" as Name, number, hudsonVersion, Label, Result, Description, JobType, User, NodeName nodrop
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| if(Result matches "SUCCESS", ":white-heavy-check-mark:", ":prohibited:") as icon
| lookup utf as Result from https://s3.amazonaws.com/sumologic-app-data/emoji.csv on shortname=icon
| count by Name, Master, Number, hudsonVersion, Label, Result, Description, JobType, User, NodeName
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number", "result" as Name, Number, Result
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| where Result != "SUCCESS"
| count by Name,Result
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number", "jobRunDuration" as Name, Number, Duration
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| Duration/60 as Duration
| avg(Duration) as %"Duration in minutes" by Number
| fields %"Duration in minutes"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number", "jobBuildURL", "upstreamJobURL" as Name, Number, URL, UpStreamURL
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| if(isEmpty(URL) ,"", tourl(URL, concat("Build URL - ", name))) as %"Build URL"
| parse field=URL "*://*/" as domain, url_base nodrop
| if(isEmpty(UpStreamURL) ,"", tourl(concat(domain, "://",url_base,"/",UpStreamURL), concat("UpStream URL - ", name))) as %"Upstream Build URL"
| replace(URL, concat("/",number,"/"), "") as Config_URL
| concat(Config_URL, "/configure") as Config_URL
| tourl(Config_URL, concat("Config URL - ", name)) as %"Configuration URL"
| count by Master, %"Build URL", %"Upstream Build URL", %"Configuration URL"
| fields Master, %"Build URL", %"Upstream Build URL", %"Configuration URL"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number", "jobMetaData", "jobStartTime", "triggerCauses" as Name, Number, jobMetaData, jobStartTime, triggerCauses nodrop
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| count by jobStartTime, triggerCauses, jobMetaData
| fields- _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Test_Result {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number" as Name, Number
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| json "testResult" as statusValues
| parse regex field=statusValues "(?<TestResult>\{[^\}]+\})" multi
| json auto field=TestResult
| className as %"Class Name" | testName as %"Test Name"| duration/60 as Duration | status as %"Test Status"
| concat(%"Class Name",".",%"Test Name") as %"Test Name"
| Duration/60 as Duration
| sum(Duration) as %"Test Duration in minutes" by %"Test Name"
| sort by %"Test Duration in minutes"
| limit 10

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Pipeline_Stages {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number" as Name, Number
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| json "stages" as StagesPipeline
| parse regex field = StagesPipeline "(?<json_added_blob>\{[^\}]+(?:\}\}|\}))" multi
| json field=json_added_blob "id", "stageId", "name", "startTime", "duration", "status", "steps", "error" as ID, %"Stage ID", %"Stage Name", %"Start Time", %"Stage Duration", %"Stage Status", %"Stage Steps", %"Stage Error" nodrop
| sum(%"Stage Duration") as %"Stage Duration in seconds" by %"Stage Name"
| sort by  %"Stage Duration in seconds"
| limit 5

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Scm_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "jobName", "buildNumber", "scmURLs", "branches", "scmType", "revision" as Name, Number, scmURLs, branches, scmType, revision
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| count by Name, Number, scmURLs, branches, scmType, revision
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Pipeline_Stages {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number" as Name, Number
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| json "stages" as StagesPipeline   
| parse regex field = StagesPipeline "(?<json_added_blob>\{[^\}]+(?:\}\}|\}))" multi
| json field=json_added_blob "id", "stageId", "name", "startTime", "duration", "status", "steps", "error" as ID, %"Stage ID", %"Stage Name", %"Start Time", %"Stage Duration", %"Stage Status", %"Stage Steps", %"Stage Error" nodrop
//| where %"Stage Status" matches {{StageStatus}}
| replace (%"Stage Error", ",", "\n\n") as %"Stage Error"
| replace (%"Stage Steps", ",\"", "\n\n") as %"Stage Steps"
| replace (%"Stage Steps", ",", "\n") as %"Stage Steps"
| count by ID, %"Stage ID", %"Stage Name", %"Start Time", %"Stage Status", %"Stage Duration", %"Stage Error", %"Stage Steps"
| tolong(ID) as ID
| sort by ID
| fields - _count, ID

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Pipeline_Stages {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number" as Name, Number
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| json "stages" as StagesPipeline
| parse regex field = StagesPipeline "(?<json_added_blob>\{[^\}]+(?:\}\}|\}))" multi
| json field=json_added_blob "id", "stageId", "name", "startTime", "duration", "status", "steps", "error" as ID, %"Stage ID", %"Stage Name", %"Start Time", %"Stage Duration", %"Stage Status", %"Stage Steps", %"Stage Error" nodrop
| sum(%"Stage Duration") as %"Stage Duration in seconds" by %"Stage Name"
| sort by  %"Stage Duration in seconds"
| limit 5

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Scm_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "jobName", "buildNumber", "changeLog" as Name, Number, Commit
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| where !isEmpty(Commit)
| count as Count by Master, Commit
| fields Master, Commit
| limit 10

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Test_Result {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number" as Name, Number
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" AND Number matches "{{Number}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| json "testResult" as statusValues
| parse regex field=statusValues "(?<TestResult>\{[^\}]+\})" multi
| json auto field=TestResult
| where status="Failed"
| className as %"Class Name" | testName as %"Test Name"| duration/60 as %"Test Duration" | status as %"Test Status"
| errorStackTrace as %"Error Stack Trace"| errorDetails as %"Error Details"
| count by Master, %"Class Name", %"Test Name", %"Test Duration", %"Error Stack Trace", %"Error Details"
|fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins*
| _sourceHost as Master
| _sourceName as SourceName
| where SourceName matches "{{Name}}#{{Number}}*" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| parse field=_raw "[*] *" as Time, %"Log Message"
| trim (%"Log Message")
| count by Time, Master, %"Log Message"
| sort by Time
| fields Time, Master, %"Log Message"
| limit 50

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins*
| _sourceHost as Master
| _sourceName as SourceName
| where SourceName matches "{{Name}}#{{Number}}*" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| parse field=_raw "[*] *" as Time, %"Log Message"
| trim (%"Log Message")
| where %"Log Message" matches "*WARNING*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*ERROR*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*fail*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*warning*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*error*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*fail*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Exception*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Fail*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Error*"
| count by Time, Master, %"Log Message"
| sort by Time
| fields Time, Master, %"Log Message"
| limit 20

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name" as Name
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" 
| first(_raw) as message by Name, Master
| parse regex field=message "\"(?<Key>.*?)\":(?<Value>.*?),"  multi
| where key in ("jobBuildURL", "upstreamJobURL", "hudsonVersion")
| json field=message "jobBuildURL", "number" as URL, number
| replace(URL, concat("/",number,"/"), "") as URL
| concat(URL, "/configure") as Config_URL
| if(key="hudsonVersion" , Config_URL, Value) as Value
| replace(Value, "\"", "") as Value
| parse field=URL "*://*/" as domain, url_base nodrop
| if(key="upstreamJobURL" , if(isEmpty(value), "",concat(domain, "://",url_base,"/",Value)), Value) as Value
| if(Key="hudsonVersion", "CONFIG URL", if(Key="jobBuildURL", "BUILD URL", "UPSTREAM JOB URL")) as Key
| if(isEmpty(value) ,"-", tourl(Value, Key)) as URL
| where URL != "-"
| fields Master, URL

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "result" as Name, Result
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| count as Total_Build

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "result" as Name, Result
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| if((Result="SUCCESS"),1,0) as successfulEvent 
| sum(successfulEvent) as count_success, count 
| (count_success/_count)*100 as successPercent
| fields successPercent

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "result" as Name, Result
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| where !(Result matches "SUCCESS")
| count as Failed

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "result", "jobRunDuration" as Name, Result, Duration
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| Duration/60 as Duration
| max(Duration) by Name

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "jobRunDuration", "number", "result", "name", "jobBuildURL" as %"Duration in minutes", Number, Result, Name, URL
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| tourl(URL, Name) as Name
| if(Result matches "SUCCESS", ":white-heavy-check-mark:", ":prohibited:") as icon
| lookup utf as Result from https://s3.amazonaws.com/sumologic-app-data/emoji.csv on shortname=icon
| count by Master, Name, Number, Result, _messageTime
| sort by _messageTime
| fields - _count, _messageTime

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name" as Name
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| json "nodeName", "result" as %"Node Name", Result
| if(Result matches "SUCCESS", 1, 0) as Success
| if(Result matches "FAILURE", 1, 0) as Failure
| if(Result matches "ABORTED", 1, 0) as Aborted
| if(Result matches "UNSTABLE", 1, 0) as Unstable
| count as Total_Logs, sum(Success) as Successes, sum(Failure) as Failures, sum(Aborted) as Abort, sum(Unstable) as Unstable by %"Node Name"
| (Successes/Total_Logs) as Successful
| (Failures/Total_Logs) as Failed
| (Abort/Total_Logs) as Aborted
| (Unstable/Total_Logs) as Unstable
| fields %"Node Name", Successful, Failed, Aborted, Unstable

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "jobRunDuration", "result" as Name, Duration, Result
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| Duration/60 as Duration
| timeslice 10m
| avg(Duration) as %"Duration in minutes" by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(10m)
| outlier %"Duration in minutes"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number", "result", "jobRunDuration" as Name, Number, Result, Duration
| where name matches "{{Name}}"
| Duration/60 as Duration
| avg(Duration) as %"Duration in minutes" by Number
| toLong(Number)
| sort by Number asc
| concat("#", Number) as Number

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name" as Name
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| json "result" as Result
| if(Result matches "SUCCESS", 1, 0) as Success
| if(Result matches "FAILURE", 1, 0) as Failure
| if(Result matches "ABORTED", 1, 0) as Aborted
| if(Result matches "UNSTABLE", 1, 0) as Unstable
| timeslice 10m
| count as Total_Logs, sum(Success) as Successes, sum(Failure) as Failures, sum(Aborted) as Abort, sum(Unstable) as Unstable by _timeslice
| (Successes/Total_Logs) as Successful
| (Failures/Total_Logs) as Failed
| (Abort/Total_Logs) as Aborted
| (Unstable/Total_Logs) as Unstable
| fields _timeslice, Successful, Failed, Aborted, Unstable

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number", "result" as Name, Number, Result
| where name matches "{{Name}}"
| json "testResult.failures", "testResult.passes", "testResult.skips", "testResult.total" as Failed, Passed, Skipped, Total
| avg(Failed) as Failed, avg(Passed) as Passed, avg(Skipped) as Skipped, avg(Total) as Total by Number
| toLong(Number)
| sort by Number asc
| concat("#", Number) as Number

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Pipeline_Stages {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name" as Name
| where name matches "{{Name}}"
| json "stages" as StagesPipeline
| parse regex field = StagesPipeline "(?<json_added_blob>\{[^\}]+(?:\}\}|\}))" multi
| json field=json_added_blob "id", "name", "startTime", "duration", "status", "steps", "error" as %"Stage ID", %"Stage Name", %"Start Time", %"Stage Duration", %"Stage Status", %"Stage Steps", %"Stage Error" nodrop
| where !(%"Stage Status" matches "SUCCESS")
| replace (%"Stage Error", ",", "\n") as %"Stage Error"
| count as Count by %"Stage Name", %"Stage Error"
| limit 10

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Scm_Status {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "jobName" as Name
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| json "eventTime", "changeLog" as Time, Commit
| where Commit != "[]"
| replace(Commit, ",", "\n\n") as Commit
| replace(Commit, "author", "\nauthor") as Commit
| replace(Commit, "message", "\nmessage") as Commit
| replace(Commit, "[", "") as Commit
| replace(Commit, "]", "") as Commit
| count by Master, Time, Commit
| sort by Time
| fields - _count
| limit 10

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins*
| _sourceHost as Master
| _sourceName as SourceName
| where SourceName matches "{{Name}}#*"
| parse field=_raw "[*] *" as Time, %"Log Message"
| trim (%"Log Message")
| where %"Log Message" matches "*WARNING*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*ERROR*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*fail*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*warning*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*error*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*fail*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Exception*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Fail*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Error*"
| count as Count by Master, %"Log Message"
| sort by Count
| limit 10

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Config_Change {{Name}}
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "userId", "userName", "eventTime", "message", "fileDetails.Old_File_Data", "fileDetails.Current_File_Data" as %"User Id", %"User Name", Time, %"Config Message", %"Old File Data", %"Current File Data" nodrop
| parse field=%"Config Message" "* changed configuration for the file jobs/*/config.xml." as User, Name
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| base64Decode(%"Old File Data") as %"Old File Data"
| base64Decode(%"Current File Data") as %"Current File Data"
| count by Time, Master, %"User Id", %"User Name", %"Current File Data", %"Old File Data"
| sort by Time
| fields - _count
| limit 10

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins*
| _sourceHost as Master
| _sourceName as SourceName
| where SourceName matches "{{Name}}#*" 
| parse field=_raw "[*] *" as Time, %"Log Message"
| trim (%"Log Message")
| count by Time, Master, %"Log Message"
| sort by Time
| fields Time, Master, %"Log Message"
| limit 50

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "label", "result" as Name, Label, Result
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Result matches "{{Result}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| count as TotalBuilds

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "result" as Name, Result
| where Name matches "{{Name}}"
| if((Result="SUCCESS"),1,0) as successfulEvent 
| sum(successfulEvent) as count_success, count 
| (count_success/_count)*100 as successPercent
| fields successPercent

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "label", "result" as Name, Label, Result
| where !(Result matches "SUCCESS") and Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| count as Failures

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "label", "result", "jobRunDuration" as Name, Label, Result, Duration
| Duration/60 as Duration
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Result matches "{{Result}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| max(Duration)

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name","number","label","jobRunDuration", "result" as Name, Number, Label, Duration, Result
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Result matches "{{Result}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| Duration/60 as Duration
| timeslice 10m
| avg(Duration) as %"Duration in minutes" by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(10m)
| outlier %"Duration in minutes"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "jobRunDuration", "number", "result", "name", "jobBuildURL", "label" as Duration, Number, Result, Name, URL, Label nodrop
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Result matches "{{Result}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| _sourceHost as Master
| tourl(URL, Name) as Name
| if(Result matches "SUCCESS", ":white-heavy-check-mark:", ":prohibited:") as icon
| lookup utf as Result from https://s3.amazonaws.com/sumologic-app-data/emoji.csv on shortname=icon
| count by Master, Name, Number, Result, Label, _messageTime
| sort by _messageTime
| fields - _count, _messageTime

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "jobRunDuration", "number", "result", "name", "label" as Duration, Number, Result, Name, Label nodrop
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Result matches "{{Result}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| concat(Name,"#" ,Number) as Name
| Duration/60 as Duration
| avg(Duration) as %"Duration in minutes" by Name, _messageTime
| sort by _messageTime asc
| fields - _messageTime

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "result", "label", "jobRunDuration" as Name, Result, Label, Duration
| where !(Result matches "SUCCESS") and Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| Duration/60 as Duration
| avg(Duration) as %"Duration in minutes" by Name, Duration
| sort by %"Duration in minutes"
| fields - Duration
| limit 10

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "label","result", "jobRunDuration" as Name,Label, Result, Duration
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Result matches "{{Result}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| count by Name, Result, Master
| transpose row Name, Master column Result as %"SUCCESS", %"FAILURE", %"ABORTED", %"UNSTABLE"
| compare with timeshift 1d
| concat(if(isNull(SUCCESS), tolong(0), SUCCESS), " / ", if(isNull(SUCCESS_1d), tolong(0), SUCCESS_1d)) as %"Compare Success"
| concat(if(isNull(FAILURE), tolong(0), FAILURE), " / ", if(isNull(FAILURE_1d), tolong(0), FAILURE_1d)) as %"Compare Failure"
| concat(if(isNull(ABORTED), tolong(0), ABORTED), " / ", if(isNull(ABORTED_1d), tolong(0), ABORTED_1d)) as %"Compare Aborted"
| concat(if(isNull(UNSTABLE), tolong(0), UNSTABLE), " / ", if(isNull(UNSTABLE_1d), tolong(0), UNSTABLE_1d)) as %"Compare Unstable"
| fields Master, Name, %"Compare Success", %"Compare Failure", %"Compare Aborted", %"Compare Unstable"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "result", "jobRunDuration", "label" as Name, Result, Duration, Label
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Result matches "{{Result}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| where Result matches "SUCCESS"
| Duration/60 as Duration
| avg(Duration) as %"Duration in minutes" by Duration, Name
| sort by %"Duration in minutes"
| fields - Duration
| limit 10

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name", "number","label", "result" as Name, Number, Label, Result nodrop
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Result matches "{{Result}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| timeslice 10m
| if(Result matches "SUCCESS", "Success", "Failure") as Result
| count by _timeslice, Result
| transpose row _timeslice column Result

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "name","label","result" as Name, Label, Result
| where Name matches "{{Name}}" and Label matches "{{Label}}" and Result matches "{{Result}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| if(Result matches "SUCCESS", 1, 0) as Success
| if(Result matches "FAILURE", 1, 0) as Failure
| if(Result matches "ABORTED", 1, 0) as Aborted
| if(Result matches "UNSTABLE", 1, 0) as Unstable
| timeslice 30m
| count as Total_Logs, sum(Success) as Successes, sum(Failure) as Failures, sum(Aborted) as Abort, sum(Unstable) as Unstable by _timeslice
| (Successes/Total_Logs) as Successful
| (Failures/Total_Logs) as Failed
| (Abort/Total_Logs) as Aborted
| (Unstable/Total_Logs) as Unstable
| fields _timeslice, Successful, Failed, Aborted, Unstable
